title: Plato — A world in every stone.
description: Twelve subject-shaped mosaics made with Plato’s hand-cut tesserae, mineral pigments, and open negative space.

courses.name: Mathematics
courses.subtitle: The beauty of a pattern.
courses.description: A bold pi symbol built entirely from hand-cut moss-dark stone. Its broad roof and gently curved legs make mathematics immediately recognisable, with a small ochre accent at the foot.
courses.detail: Pi symbol · broad stone strokes · moss and ochre

courses.name: Physics
courses.subtitle: Everything is in relation.
courses.description: Three crossing ribbons of lapis and blue-grey stone trace an atom around a substantial nucleus. Small dark electron clusters punctuate the open orbital silhouette.
courses.detail: Three orbital ribbons · central nucleus · lapis and blue-grey

courses.name: Chemistry
courses.subtitle: Small bonds. Vast possibilities.
courses.description: A substantial benzene ring branches into rose-coloured atom clusters. Plum bond ribbons, spare double bonds, and hand-cut edges give the molecular silhouette a tactile depth.
courses.detail: Benzene ring · branching bonds · plum and rose atoms

courses.name: Biology
courses.subtitle: The shape of living things.
courses.description: Two substantial strands of pine and celadon stone twist into a gently tilted double helix. Short limestone bridges span the open spaces between them.
courses.detail: Double helix · paired bridges · pine and celadon

courses.name: Computer science
courses.subtitle: An idea, branching outward.
courses.description: A broad circuit tree branches from one root into four square terminals. Slate routes, pale stone edges, and terracotta endpoints make a precise, recognisable silhouette.
courses.detail: Branching tree · four terminals · slate and terracotta

courses.name: Astronomy
courses.subtitle: A little piece of the infinite.
courses.description: A solid gold-toned planet meets wide, tilted lapis rings, with three small tessellated stars nearby. The stones make Saturn’s silhouette, including its generous open spaces.
courses.detail: Solid ringed planet · tessellated stars · gold and twilight lapis

courses.name: Economics
courses.subtitle: The shape of possibility
courses.description: Four stone pillars rise at measured intervals beneath a sweeping ochre curve. Their open spaces and ascending rhythm turn growth into a small piece of architecture.

courses.name: World History
courses.subtitle: Built across centuries
courses.description: A classical temple assembled from sandstone fragments: a broad triangular pediment, four subtly tapered columns, and three stepped foundation courses. Light passes freely between the columns.

courses.name: Literature
courses.subtitle: A world unfolding
courses.description: An open book in warm ivory stone, with curved paper leaves, a plum-gray binding, and a fine cover beneath. Six spare lines follow the natural sweep of the pages, leaving their pale surfaces open and quiet.

courses.name: Psychology
courses.subtitle: Patterns of thought
courses.description: Two sculptural lobes are built from lavender and rose-earth stones. Winding folds move through their solid surfaces, divided by a narrow seam of light and joined at a small descending stem.

courses.name: Music Theory
courses.subtitle: Intervals in stone
courses.description: A warm bronze lyre has substantial curled arms, a rounded stone soundbox, and five straight, evenly spaced strings. Gold inlay follows the bowl and the central string, giving its measured intervals a gentle radiance.

courses.name: Environmental Science
courses.subtitle: The shape of growth
courses.description: A fern is assembled leaf by leaf from moss-green stones. Broad, asymmetrical blades taper toward their tips, and open air separates each pair as the stem rises into a small unfurling curl.
